title: Conditional κ = 0.001698511343697629: entrance raise of 24 copy buffers on the handoff T74 words
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001698511343697629329051733814187744630805511096704593311278…** (3046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `13ad8a24e7456aebd54902329c433eacf69faa3780d2f33d8661a5204e3ea2a6`). This package continues PR2322's (Vlado Vojdanovski) handoff construction and our own PR2374 exact owner fill on it (owner-map line: PR2349, PR2363 mason-hale). The circuit change of PR2322 (four coherent helper handoffs, helpers 438 to 434), its call order and windows are unchanged. New in this package, by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance: the entrance frames of 24 entering width-8 copy-buffer helpers per word are raised from dimension 1 to 2 (width 8 becomes width 7; start_extra and frames re-solved, gates, warps and restore order unchanged; local profile {1:2359, 2:632, 3:330, 4:120, 5:38, 8:8}, width inventory {4:33, 5:9, 7:62, 8:90, 9:240} per call; audited forward and dual with tamper controls), and an exact owner fill for the new inventory (leftover idle {1:20824, 3:6695, 5:1, 48:25302}). Also carried: the private cleanup-buffer stock accounting (PR2309 Dugongue, PR2315 thakrarsagar; physical stock 66826), the pooled-slot time binding (PR2301, PR1959), and the supplier endpoints certified to 1e-3000 with the fixed-grid-maximum outer kappa C - 1/F - B (PR2180 / PR2161, dataisfire; PR2168). Conditional final kappa = 0.0016985113436976293290517338141877446308…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0016956312947088376702639978708509688232…(2995 digits)). It exceeds PR2374 (our previous package) by 1.31639E-6 and PR2312 by 1.31639E-6. grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; 63 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls; the PR1956 carried bootstrap cutoffs and PR1964 Lemma G label stage are retained.

## Verification

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse {'base': 'e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e', 'extra': '7b0e9fbda32749aabc7e156d9fe09bceb0624a178628fe69e5dfea783462f905'}; its complex endpoint 849255671848814664525866907093... brackets the ledger's b = 1698511343697629329051733814187744630805…(3078 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3081 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016985113436976293290517338141877446308…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).

Full package-owned verification passed in 128.75 seconds. The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.
